task_specification.objective: Restore the preserved authored cemetery as a dense, larger traversable arena with stable landmark visibility, collision, perimeter depth, and escape lanes during ordinary movement, while replacing any text-stacked weapon or upgrade choices with a truthful, focusable visual hierarchy.

diagnosis.root_cause: The intact authored cemetery package loads, but its runtime binding remains sparse and flat: landmark visibility is occluded, perimeter/external depth is weak, and spatial contracts may drift from visible geometry during traversal. The existing choice presenter also still requires an explicit authored visual-hierarchy guarantee rather than text-stacked documentation styling.

stop_conditions: Do not replace, split, duplicate, hide, extract, or surgically edit the preserved authored cemetery package.
Stop after the bounded authored-world repair and explicit choice-hierarchy implementation are ready for Tester recapture.
Do not expand into deferred tester-coverage work or unrelated combat/audio changes.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy from prior transform tuning: restore the single authored environment instance's world datum and wrapper/binding, rebase spawn/objective/navigation/collision and camera framing onto native streets, minimize proxy clutter, and explicitly replace text-stacked choice presentation with an icon-led adapter while preserving authoritative values and existing gameplay systems.

code: Run existing project import/boot and native validation checks; preserve passing host_godot_boot and native_godot_project baselines.

Inspect scene/script references for one authoritative authored cemetery instance, native street-based anchors, valid collision/navigation/boundary bindings, and no duplicated/generated replacement world geometry.

Verify the choice presenter replaces text-stacked cards, filters unchanged and placeholder rows, limits deltas to three, binds authoritative current/new values, and exposes keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus styling with debounced confirmation.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime/Tester recaptures the failed release_convergence_authored_cemetery_composition_contract cells with spatial-coordinate and movement-effect probes.

Replay ordinary movement from spawn through the critical route, central building/landmarks, and perimeter; capture runtime state and screenshots at spawn, route, cardinal landmark, and boundary views, verifying collision, no pass-through, no void, no disappearance, and no occlusion drift.

Exercise an upgrade-choice state with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/selection; verify truthful deltas, applied upgrade state before resume, held-confirm debounce, and existing Result/Retry operation.
visual: Compare shipped gameplay screenshots against the bound Mournlight reference for dense authored cemetery composition, human-scale silhouettes, warm lantern versus cool moonlight hierarchy, layered external depth, readable landmarks, and clear escape lanes.
Confirm native streets, buildings, props, and materials provide the visual fill; reject matte/proxy stand-ins, large empty finished-art planes, floating props, or flat low-contrast framing.

Confirm choice cards lead with recognizable silhouettes/icons, restrained copy, compact aligned deltas, no CURRENT NEW/LOCKED placeholders, and distinct focus/hover/selected states without documentation-like text stacks.

done_when: The runtime contains one intact authoritative authored cemetery environment instance; native streets/terrain, structures, props, materials, and landmarks remain visible without duplicated or generated replacement roads, floors, or facades.
The playable area has larger traversable scale (expand the authored datum and/or rebase anchors onto native streets) plus a coherent external world with external depth beyond the route.

The central building and each required landmark remain readable from spawn, the critical route, and cardinal views during ordinary movement / movement replay; no landmark disappearance or camera occlusion drift occurs.

Collision agrees with visible geometry around the central building, routes, and perimeter boundary: movement cannot pass through structures, cross the boundary, or expose void; navigation and spawn/objective anchors are grounded on authored streets.
The perimeter has stable visible depth and clear escape lanes under the shipped camera, with no floating props, invisible barriers, or proxy-floor presentation.
Any text-stacked weapon or upgrade choices are replaced by an authored visual hierarchy led by recognizable weapon/upgrade silhouettes or icons, followed by compact stat icons and restrained copy.

Each choice shows truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas; unchanged, exhaustive, NEW, and LOCKED placeholder rows are omitted from the CURRENT value column.

Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, unavailable, newly unlocked, and selected states are visually distinct without changing card dimensions or hiding authoritative tradeoffs; the selected upgrade applies before resumed play, and held confirmation is debounced.
tasks.instructions: Inspect and repair the candidate's authored-world binding using the preserved single cemetery package. Restore/rebase its outer datum, playable boundary, spawn and objective anchors, collision, navigation, and camera framing onto the package's native streets. Expand to a larger traversable scale and retain coherent external world depth; keep the central building/landmarks visible and readable from spawn, critical route, and cardinal views during ordinary movement. Align collision and perimeter boundaries to prevent pass-through, void exposure, landmark disappearance, or occlusion drift, and remove or minimize unrelated proxy/support clutter without hiding or duplicating native authored children. Explicitly replace text-stacked weapon and upgrade choices with an authored visual hierarchy: lead with silhouettes/icons, use compact stat icons, show truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas, omit unchanged rows and never use NEW or LOCKED as CURRENT placeholders, and implement complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states with debounced confirmation. Preserve existing camera, Warden, weapon strategy, vitality, Result, Retry, and authored package assets, then leave the project ready for Tester movement, spatial, and choice-state recapture.
tasks.title: Restore authored cemetery scale, landmark visibility, collision, perimeter, and replace text-stacked choice UI
